=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- Requirement: "Update ... documentation" to describe that waivers suppress only findings with the same non-empty finding ID and matching recorded fields; proximity suppression is removed.
  Expected change site: README.md, the "Security backstop" paragraph below §12g; docs/plans/security-pass-convergence-plan.md, the D5 heading.
  Evidence of absence: README.md:2629 still reads: "Waivers still match exact IDs; location-based suppression now also requires equal severity and exploit scenario, so a new nearby vulnerability in the same category is not hidden. Legacy rows without an exploit scenario can suppress only by exact ID, provided any recorded category and severity still match." The new code (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:6411-6456 and scripts/security_audit.sh:1769-1803) drops location-based suppression entirely — waivers match only when a non-empty `finding_id` exactly matches a waiver's, plus the recorded category, severity and exploit scenario. The README paragraph describes a hybrid mode the implementation no longer supports, so operators reading the README will believe location-based suppression still applies and may be surprised when their waived-line finding is re-reported.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Requirement: Update D5's heading in the security-pass convergence plan to reflect that fuzzy matching was removed.
  Expected change site: docs/plans/security-pass-convergence-plan.md, line 216, heading "D5 — Waivers persist in project state and match exact-or-fuzzy".
  Evidence of absence: Heading at line 216 still says "match exact-or-fuzzy" while the body at lines 218-225 (updated by this PR) explicitly states "The fuzzy half was later removed (#6987): a waiver now suppresses only a finding with the same non-empty `finding_id` whose category, severity and exploit scenario match every value the waiver recorded." The heading contradicts the body it titles and contradicts the implementation. The semantic-cache / agent retrieval that pulls this heading will return "exact-or-fuzzy" and mislead future operators.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Requirement: One changelog fragment for this PR. CLAUDE.md §22 (CHANGELOG Entries) requires a fragment for PRs that change observable behavior; waiver suppression semantics is an operator-visible behavior change (a waived line in the same file/category is no longer auto-suppressed, and consumer repos receive the new behavior on the next @stable sync).
  Expected change site: changelog.d/6987-*.md (new file), alongside the other security-pass fragments in that directory (e.g., 6906-security-cap-low-medium-advisory.md, 6755-merged-pr-guard-shell-wrappers.md).
  Evidence of absence: No file matching changelog.d/*6987* or changelog.d/*waiver* exists; the changelog.d directory contains 30 unrelated fragments. Without a fragment, scripts/assemble_changelog.py will not surface this change in CHANGELOG.md for consumers, and the behavioral change ("proximity suppression removed, exact finding_id required") will be invisible to operators who only read CHANGELOG.md before syncing.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
